prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create an exceptionally beautiful image for a contemporary premium pet photography and memories website. Art direction: playful fashion editorial, exquisite detail, clean sculptural composition, luminous soft daylight, rich but restrained pastel colours, tactile materials, delightful personality. Prioritise aesthetic impact over literal app-output realism. The pet must look alive, sweet and naturally expressive, with believable anatomy and finely resolved fur. No human body, no human hands, no extra limbs, no stock-photo props clutter, no sepia filter, no brown vintage room, no app interface, no watermark, no logos. No lettering unless explicitly specified. Full bleed, no outer border. Luxury independent pet photobook, landscape overhead photograph. An open wide ivory linen-bound book on a periwinkle-blue tabletop. Beautiful modern editorial spreads with an enormous close-up sleepy cream cat photograph on one page and a small sunlit cat-paw photograph with generous blank margin on the other. Tiny readable caption OUR LITTLE DAYS. One soft yellow ribbon bookmark, natural paper grain, afternoon side light, exquisite crisp shadows, airy quiet composition. No other objects. Intended final composition 1600:1200; keep face, ears and important artwork comfortably within the central safe area for a small crop.
